title: Petition of Marathon Lines, Inc. for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity under the provisions of G.L. c.159A, § 7 for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain public ways in the Towns of Framingham, Brookline, the City of Boston and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority, restricted to students, faculty, personnel, and employees of Boston University and the University hospital.
